title: 달빛 다리
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 3, take A. ALFHEIM: one LONG MOONLIT BRIDGE, exactly TWO glowing circular MOON GATES positioned at its TWO ENDS, with a LARGE CRESCENT MOON above. Take A: mostly side-on wide establishing view of a long elegant silver-lavender arched bridge spanning x25-75%, both glowing round rings clearly readable at x28% and x72%, no additional rings or gates. This whole bridge is the single central landmark. Bridge walkway and distant cloud-sea horizon are low at y70-74%; each circular gate rises above it. Large crescent at x24% y23% casts the key moonlight from upper left. Open quiet indigo night sky, violet trees in modest clusters, lilac stone and white-blue glows matching realm reference. No banners or markings, no stars arranged like symbols, no figures.
